summary: The pivotal phase 2 trial missed its primary endpoint. Sponsor-reported secondary activity does not resolve this efficacy concern; NDA acceptance and priority review provide procedural support only.
pivotalQuestion: Can the secondary endpoint evidence establish efficacy for FOP despite the nonsignificant pivotal primary endpoint?

factors.rationale: Mirum’s Form 10-Q reports a nonsignificant primary endpoint. Sponsor-reported secondary reductions in heterotopic ossification and flare activity carry nominal p-values, leaving the pivotal efficacy concern unresolved.
The supplied packet provides no interpretable safety results.
The supplied packet provides no product-linked manufacturing or facility-compliance evidence.
Sponsors report NDA acceptance and priority review for FOP in patients aged 12 and older, with a September 26 review target. These milestones do not establish efficacy or approval.
